title: SCPs Tracker and 035 Pickup
features:
Has some cool features, nothing super surprising besides infinite ammo and other stuff I guess.

I'm planning to add more things including showing 106 pocket dimension exit, noclip, item esp, etc.., as well as fixing some things like player esp, because it is not in it's greatest as of now.

Item trackers only have two items.. I am aware, and I will add more very soon hopefully.

Please read the extra informations for each button if it doesn't work properly, it should be three dots next to the button. Most of them just explain what the button does in detail, but some have specific requirements you manually have to do before using it, like the infinite ammo one.

This is my first attempt on making an exploit, so please be gentle lol.
